newsitem.title: JAPAN: KOMATSU TO SELL PLASTICS UNIT TO SEKISUI CHEMICAL.
newsitem.headline: KOMATSU TO SELL PLASTICS UNIT TO SEKISUI CHEMICAL.

text.p: Sekisui Chemical Co Ltd will buy all of the outstanding shares of Komatsu Ltd's unit which produces plastics, Sekisui and Komatsu said in a joint statement on Friday.
A spokesman of machinery maker Komatsu said that the sale of 12 million shares in Komatsu Plastics Industry Co Ltd meant that Komatsu would withdraw from the production and sales of plastics.
Komatsu Plastics is currently 99.5 percent owned by the Komatsu group, the spokesman said.
Parent Komatsu and Sekisui said they expected to sign an agreement by the end of this month after finalising the details of the deal.
The Komatsu spokesman declined to comment on the value of the deal.
